# Animstudio Complete Technical & Feature Specification

## Introduction
Animstudio is an all-in-one 2D & 3D vector animation web application, vector graphics editor, and character rigging studio designed to run seamlessly in the browser and as a lightweight Android app. Built as a modern, accessible alternative to Adobe Animate, Animstudio empowers animators, storytellers, illustrators, and students worldwide to create professional cartoon movies, moral stories (kahani banane wala app), explainer videos, and interactive animated content.

## Core Tools & Modules
1. **Vector Drawing Engine**:
   - Vector Pen Tool with cubic Bezier curves and corner smoothing.
   - Pressure-sensitive Brush Tool with stabilization and tapering.
   - Shape Tools (Rectangle, Ellipse, Polygon, Star, Line).
   - Direct Selection and Point Editing.
   - Real-time stroke width and color fill palette.

2. **Timeline & Frame-by-Frame System**:
   - Multi-layer timeline with independent layer locking, visibility, and opacity.
   - Keyframe interpolation, inbetweening, and auto-tweening.
   - Onion skinning with customizable forward and backward frame visibility and color tints.
   - FPS adjustment (12fps, 24fps film, 30fps, 60fps smooth playback).

3. **Skeletal Rigging & Inverse Kinematics (IK)**:
   - Node-based hierarchical bone rigging system.
   - Bind vector shapes and raster parts to skeletal bones.
   - Pin constraints, angle limits, and interactive limb dragging.

4. **3D Extrusion & Mesh Deformer**:
   - 3D Stroke Memory: Extrude flat 2D artwork into 3D isometric perspectives.
   - Liquify Lattice Deformer for organic squash & stretch animation principles.

5. **Swap Studio (Drawing Substitution)**:
   - Preset and custom library for mouth shapes, phonemes (lip sync), hand poses, and eye expressions.

6. **Export & Sharing**:
   - Direct WebCodecs / MediaRecorder MP4 & WebM export up to 4K resolution at 60fps.
   - High-fidelity looping Animated GIF export.
   - AnimStudio Project (.animstudio / JSON) import and export.
   - Android Native APK installation.
